Receipt artifacts are protected captured, compared with declared SHA and retained from that same captured raw; a repeated capture refuses changed bytes. Retained bytes and exact serialized disposition get protected readback.

The two source tests exercise real owned byte replacement/hardlink denial and controlled admission-field refusal; they make no actual native or receipt-issuance claim.

findings.finding: Public-only stage admission remains incomplete. Headless command/session log fields and unattended/backup log_ref fields are joined before a stage-local basename/known-label allowlist. CapturedEvidence is protected but rooted at PROJECT, so an absolute path to an ordinary private file within PROJECT replaces the stage prefix and reaches a kernel read. Broad log/kit globs also admit unexpected ordinary files without a producer commitment.
findings.minimal_fix: Before any referenced capture, require each expected stage log label/name to be a known canonical direct-child .log and derive its path from the trusted stage root. Reject unexpected glob results. Admit kit/report files from the exact expected public inventory and producer commitments (including version inventory) rather than copying every discovered ordinary file.
findings.regression: Use a mocked capture sentinel and an absolute project-private reference; require refusal with zero capture calls and no actual private access. Also reject an unexpected stage log/kit entry. Literal dot-dot is already rejected by artifact_bytes/safe_relative.

findings.finding: The native04 identity/group/passed check is conditional on a declared artifact happening to be named native-observations.json. native_assertions validates names/status and evidence hashes, but does not require this primary name or validate identity. A renamed/omitted primary with self-consistent other committed assertion artifacts skips the subject check.
findings.minimal_fix: Require native-observations.json in the native04 artifact map before iteration; capture/hash/parse that exact primary and unconditionally require passed=True, identity==facts and group=PQR-04. Then admit the remaining declared closure.
findings.regression: Controlled report with the exact assertion IDs/status/hash closure but missing or renamed primary must be denied before publication; correct primary must retain existing acceptance.
